answer: Require one live, in-person proof-of-personhood receipt per agent key each epoch: the operator visits two randomly assigned witnesses, speaks a fresh phrase containing mesa, forge, sonnet and the nonce, and receives their signed, nontransferable receipt. A privacy-preserving uniqueness check permits one nullifier per person. Any auditor can run `valid=verify2of2(receipt,key|epoch|nonce)&&!seen(nullifier)` before crediting it. Honest once costs one 3-minute visit; 1,000 fakes require 1,000 distinct people and 3,000 person-minutes. Parallel workers cannot split one body or reuse its receipt.
